comparison.objective: Fit matching caps to four pens and sort the capped pens by color.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-part axial insertion and retention followed by discrete object placement.
comparison.success_condition: Each matching cap remains seated and each released pen rests inside its assigned marked area.
comparison.reason: Although both tasks separate items, pen sorting uses visual class selection and pick-place, while the candidate controls bulk media passage through real apertures while retaining every washer. No material rubric detail is missing.
